correctness.rationale: Poisson step response equals a neighboring Erlang mixture; Gamma moment and overshoot identities yield the exact analytic E_n(s). Strict cell derivative monotonicity and endpoint signs enumerate all global maxima. Signed-BV integration with strict pairwise sign disagreement gives the complete equality class. Uniform Stirling and explicit two-sided Erlang moderate-deviation inequalities show the sharp asymptotic and log-displacement for every optimizing sequence; numerical comparisons are nonessential corroboration.

value.rationale: This solves a natural exact worst-case error problem for the classical positive Szász–Kantorovich approximation operator. It gives a finite computation using only n monotone scalar roots, determines every extremizing BV signal, and identifies the nontrivial sqrt(log n/n) boundary retreat against the n^-1/2 error scale. Its mathematical purpose is a sharp discontinuity error budget and optimizer localization, not arbitrary parameter tuning.
